title: Trove calendar occurrence
description: One line of calendar/events/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a single event occurrence (recurrences expanded), keyed by id + occurrence. A snapshot of the present, rewritten whole per affected month on each sync. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

id.description: event identifier, shared across all occurrences of a recurring event

occurrence.description: the instance's original slot (RFC3339 local), stable across a reschedule, which is what makes id+occurrence a usable key

start.description: RFC3339 local start; for all-day events, local midnight

end.description: RFC3339 local end; for all-day events, 23:59:59 local

all_day.description: whether this is an all-day event

recurring.description: whether this occurrence belongs to a recurring series
